sloka: स तैर्मदात् सम्परिवार्य वाक्यैर्बलाच्च तेन प्रतिवार्यमाणैः ।प्रधर्षितस्त्यक्तभयैः समेत्य प्रकृष्यते चाप्यनवेक्ष्य दोषम् ।। ५.६१.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: sa tairmadāt samparivārya vākyairbalācca tena prativāryamāṇaiḥ ।pradharṣitastyaktabhayaiḥ sametya prakṛṣyate cāpyanavekṣya doṣam ।। 5.61.22 ।।।।

translations.english: In their drunkenness they were using abusive language and with their strength they retaliated without fear. They invaded without considering their mistakes. They caught hold of Dadhimukha and pulled him.
